ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio of approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity region covering both lobes. A contiguous low-intensity vertical geometric block is centered at the peduncle. Low-intensity perimeter banding is present along the trailing edges. Discrete low-intensity linear and circular blobs are mapped across the lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 75 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow a consistent convex trajectory. Trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal curve: concave near the median notch and convex towards the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark clusters observed at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and discrete circular clusters on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of four distinct, nearly parallel vertical linear disruptions on the left lobe and two prominent diagonal linear marks on the right lobe, breaking the high-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular low-intensity marking at the central peduncle junction; heavy texture and pigmentation at the fluke tips suggesting significant colonization or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique four-bar vertical rake mark pattern on the upper-left fluke lobe.
